profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Choice Hotels
profile.summary:
As an individual with a strong passion for technology and innovation, my journey into software engineering was ignited by my love for problem-solving and critical thinking. Graduating with a Bachelor's degree in Marketing and Real Estate, I found myself drawn to the world of coding and its potential to create impactful solutions. My initial self-study of JavaScript and Python led me to seek a more structured environment to hone my skills, and I was fortunate to be accepted into App Academy, a top-tier bootcamp with a mere 5% acceptance rate. Throughout my time at the bootcamp, I relished the challenges presented by complex problems and thrived in the collaborative environment, gaining invaluable experience in pair programming and teamwork.

Currently, as a highly motivated software engineer, I am driven by the desire to constantly learn new skills and technologies in order to excel in my field. I am dedicating time to work on diverse projects, showcasing my adaptability and eagerness to learn as I master both frontend and backend technologies. My goal is to become a senior engineer within the next few years, and I am consistently seeking opportunities to polish and expand my skillset. Beyond coding, I enjoy playing video games, strumming the guitar, and immersing myself in new cultures through travel and gastronomic exploration.

Looking towards the future, I am excited to continue my growth as a software engineer, pushing the boundaries of innovation and contributing to meaningful projects. I believe that an environment that fosters continuous learning and collaboration is the key to unlocking my full potential, and I am eager to contribute my skills and enthusiasm to a team that shares this vision. My experiences thus far have only served to fuel my passion for software engineering, and I look forward to the challenges and opportunities that lie ahead as I strive to become an exceptional engineer in this dynamic and ever-evolving field.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Designed and implemented user-facing features such as Google Sign-In and played a pivotal role in streamlining the codebase while introducing novel features to augment admin flow and user interface functionalities.

- Constructed robust API endpoints using Node.js/Express, enhancing application functionality and supporting seamless data integration for frontend consumption. Formulated dynamic solutions to backend data-shape to ensure efficient and optimized feature performance.

positions.title: Digital Marketing Intern
positions.description: Performing and gathering information on marketing research in various social media outlets in order to grow a business for a RE/MAX realtor. Organized marketing data/statistics and presented information to site supervisor in order to help gain marketing momentum for specific target audiences.

positions.title: Research And Development Intern
positions.description: Performed research and development for an online payment platform in regards to a $1.7 million dollar church building project and connected with the board through an organized presentation.

projects.title: SlackLine
projects.description: SlackLine is a cutting-edge instant messaging application built with WebSockets technology, designed to enhance seamless communication between users. With its intuitive interface and real-time messaging capabilities, SlackLine offers a dynamic and engaging experience that sets it apart from traditional chat platforms, making it the perfect tool for any team looking to streamline their communication and boost productivity.
